what: Kids Math Worksheets makes printable maths worksheets for children aged about 4 to 11, with a separate answer key page. There are eleven kinds: counting pictures, missing numbers, number lines, place value, comparing numbers with <, > and =, column addition and subtraction, fractions with shaded shapes, telling the time on clock faces, counting money, word problems and shapes.
Every sheet has a header with the child's name and the date, comes as an A4 or US Letter PDF, and can also be solved on screen with instant checking and stars.
Each worksheet has a code. The same code with the same settings always makes the same sheet, so you can print it again or share it with another family or class.
uses: A fresh sheet on any topic in seconds.
Print the same sheet for the whole class with one code.
Counting pictures, number lines and comparing with dots.
Clock faces to the hour, half hour, quarter and 5 minutes.
Coins and notes with your own currency symbol.
Solve it here with stars instead of printing.
tutorial: Tap one of the eleven types, such as Telling the time or Fractions.
Fill one page, or choose a number; more questions add pages.
For columns choose addition, subtraction and carrying. For money choose the currency symbol and whole numbers or decimals.
Type the child's name and the date, or leave them empty for blank lines. Choose A4 or US Letter.
Look through the worksheet pages and the answer key.
Press Download PDF + answer key and print at 100%, or press Solve it here to answer on screen.
features: From counting to fractions, time and money.
Always on separate pages at the end of the PDF.
The same code makes the same sheet again.
Clocks, fractions, blocks and coins stay sharp when printed.
Pick from the list or type your own; neutral drawings, not real coins.
Instant checking, stars and a gentle second try.
Arabic, Chinese, Hindi and other names print correctly.

example.title: Worked example: telling the time
example.text: Choose Telling the time, Medium and Fill one page. You get nine clock faces with times like 3:15, 7:30 and 10:45, each with two boxes for the hours and minutes. The answer key on page 2 lists every time with words, for example 3:45 (quarter to 4). Press Solve it here and a child can type 3 and 45 under each clock to earn a star.

tips: Print at 100% or Actual size so the drawings keep their shape.
Write the worksheet code on the sheet's back if you want to print it again later.
Start with Easy and move up when a child gets almost everything right.
For column sums, choose Without carrying first, then Some of each.
In fractions, an answer like 2/4 for a half is accepted on screen as the same fraction.
For quick times-table drills use Math Practice.
problems: The PDF button says it could not make the PDF
The PDF needs two small font files. Open the page once while online, then it also works offline.
Clocks or shapes look stretched on paper
Turn off Fit to page or Scale to fit in the print dialog and print at 100%.
A different code or different settings make a different sheet. Type the old code back in with the same settings.
My currency is not in the list
Choose Other and type your symbol, up to four characters, and choose whether it goes before or after the amount.
